description: List a brand's products/denominations so you can complete the selection: each entry says whether it is a FIXED denomination (buy with its exact `denomination` string; `price_sats` is the BTC cost) or a DYNAMIC range product (is_dynamic:true — buy with denomination "range" + a `product_value` within `min`..`max`; quote a specific value with wallet_giftcard_price). Returns the FULL list (fixed AND range). Gated on giftcardEnabled. Read-only, moves no money.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Defaults to the shop config country.

name: wallet_list_giftcard_products

products.description: The brand's products/denominations — FIXED (pick a denomination) AND range (pick a value in min..max).

currency.description: Fiat currency code of the face value (e.g. BRL).

denomination.description: Pass this exact string to wallet_buy_giftcard for a FIXED product; "range" for a dynamic one.

is_dynamic.description: true = custom-value (range) product: buy with denomination "range" + product_value within min..max.

max.description: Range upper bound (fiat) for a dynamic product.

min.description: Range lower bound (fiat) for a dynamic product.

price_sats.description: BTC cost in sats for a FIXED product; null for a range product (quote it with wallet_giftcard_price).

title: List a brand's denominations/products
